# Firecrawl MCP Server A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that brings [Firecrawl](https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl), the context API for AI agents, to MCP-compatible clients: search, scrape, and interact with the live web and get back clean Markdown or structured data. > Big thanks to [@vrknetha](https://github.com/vrknetha), [@knacklabs](https://www.knacklabs.ai) for the initial implementation! ## Features - Search the web, optionally with full page content for each result - Search indexes for developer sources (GitHub issues, merged pull requests, READMEs, and docs), US government sources, and scientific papers (PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv, arXiv) - Scrape any URL into clean Markdown or structured JSON - Parse PDFs and documents - Crawl a site for content from many pages, or map it to discover its URLs - Interact with pages in a real browser: click, type, fill forms, and navigate dynamic pages - Run Agent jobs for multi-source research that returns structured data - Monitor pages and get notified when their content changes - Check current and historical Firecrawl credit usage - Automatic retries and rate limiting - Cloud and self-hosted support - SSE support > Play around with [our MCP Server on MCP.so's playground](https://mcp.so/playground?server=firecrawl-mcp-server) or on [Klavis AI](https://www.klavis.ai/mcp-servers). ## When to Use This Server - Use `firecrawl_scrape` when you have a known URL and want it
